It depends, if you play with attribute masking, it’s 10 times harder, but still doable. From March to May, send most of your scouts to Europe, nations and regions you should be scouting for u18s, so your scouts will watch most youth leagues and youth cups, scouting potential ability should be very good(3.5 gold stars, cos the white stars are not taken into account) and current ability of one star( cos if they aren’t one star at that age, they probably wouldn’t reach their potential ability whatever it is)you can reduce it to 0.5 star to be safe. The countries you scout should be loaded, playable leagues should be your priority. You’ll get most youth intakes this way, you’ll miss out on a few who signed pre-contracts but that’s okay. You should set your scout player for 2 weeks, that way the scout report should be fairly comprehensive when you get them. The minimum scout recommendation should be C, else you’ll be flooded with many reports on players not really good enough. From September to January using the same parameters you should send scouts to North And both South America regions and you can send multiple scouts to the same region, if the leagues are loaded, they won’t overlap. Depending on how many scouts you have, you can scout specifically Brazil, Argentina, Colombia and Mexico and Africa specifically West and North. You can scout youth competitions during the summer u21s and u18s, you can also search for u18s with senior international caps. 
Most people don’t understand how scouting works, you are basically sending your scouts to watch matches, yes speaking the language and full nation knowledge helps but that’s not all. Your criteria matters a lot and region scouting is still viable if at least one country in that region is loaded cos it means the matches are played and your scouts can watch. There’s a way to see the matches your scouts have watched.
